label: BLESSED_2: has intellect, PERFECT_2, good as to being and IN_ACT_3 understanding
term: most blessed, typed through intellect (beatissimus; Lean `IsBlessedByUnderstanding`)
definition: IsBlessedByUnderstanding InAct GoodIn esse understanding HasIntellect g: g has intellect (HAS_INTELLECT_1), is universally perfect (PERFECT_2, DEF-UNIVERSALLY-PERFECT: in act in every respect in which anything is in act, so no being has a perfection g lacks), is good as to being (GoodIn g esse, the first conjunct of DEF-SUPREMELY-GOOD), and is in act in the respect of understanding (InAct g understanding, definition 39f50105; IN_ACT_3, the nine's formal-or-virtual act). After ST I q.26 a.1 (beatitude is the perfect good of an intellectual nature) and a.2 (beatitude belongs to God by his intellect). Example: on the stage-two route, a being with the nine, given the two existing open premises that intellect is the capacity to understand and that this capacity is exercised or in potency (DeiFiliusOperationFromIntellect). Counterexamples: a stone (no intellect); a human knower (not universally perfect); a universally perfect intellectual being not in act in understanding (Control.Controls part 5 of DeiFiliusLordBlessed). Distinguished from BLESSED_1 (the primitive Primitives.MostBlessed, having in and from itself the perfect good of an intellectual nature): BLESSED_2 does not type 'ex se' (the good is not received from another), knowing one's own sufficiency in the good possessed (self-knowledge, q.14 a.2), or the formal rather than merely virtual character of the act of understanding. BLESSED_1 is read the Thomist way (beatitude formally in the intellect, q.26 a.2); a Scotist reading (beatitude formally in the will's enjoyment) would be a further sense, not typed.
note: Analyst reading, attribution deferred: q.26 a.1-2 motivate it; no claim states it. Sibling of BLESSED_1 (disambiguation 70f4f510); the only passage between them is the open sense bridge 'Whatever is BLESSED_2 is BLESSED_1'. Reuses the understanding respect of 39f50105 rather than a new understanding predicate.
